summary: Fasgear-USB C Extension Cable 10Gbps USB 3.1 Gen 2 Type C Male to Female - Fasgear - Accessories & Spare Parts - USB C 3.1 Gen 2 Extender: Fasgear USB 3.1 C-Type Extension Cord is designed for extending the connection between USB-C devices, can be com
description_html:
USB C 3.1 Gen 2 Extender:

Fasgear USB 3.1 C-Type Extension Cord is designed for extending the connection between USB-C devices, can be compatible with Switch, Type-C smartphone or laptop for charging or data syncing. It can access hard-to-reach place and protect USB Type C female port of your device from frequent plugging and unplugging, protecting switch console from getting scratched by the dock. Support 4K Video and Audio Transmission:

Up to 60Hz 4K video signal transferring for the connection between your Mac-Book to another monitor or display with USB Type-C interface. Note: Please make sure both your input laptop and output monitor type c ports support video in and out function (Thunderbolt 3). Super Speed Charging and Syncing:

Fasgear Male USB-C to Female USB C 3.1 Gen 2 Cable Support 100 watts fast charging at MAX 20V 5A current and 10Gbps data transfer. Less time for waiting, more time for entertaining. Important note: ① This product is compatible with thunderbolt 3, but the transfer speed is limited to Max 10Gbps. ② The output wattage depend on the USB C cable that connect with Type C female port. Widely Compatibility:

Compatible for Switch Dock, Mac-Book Pro, Chromebook Pixel, Moto Z Droid, Galaxy S21/ S20 Ultra/ S20 Plus/ S10, Google Pixel 3/ 3XL/ 2, ASUS ZenPad S 8.0, Dell XPS 13/15, Lenovo Zuk Z1, HP Pavilion X2, Hua-wei Matebook/ P30/ P40 Pro, Sam-sung T5 Portable SSD & new devices with USB-C port. NOTE: When you connect APP-LE devices with some multi-function USB C hub/Docking/Station, USB function might not work. Please flip the female end of the cable and this cable can work well. What You Get:

Fasgear 1 Pack 3 feet USB C male to female adapter cable (USB 3.1 Gen 2); A 18-month worry-free warranty. Friendly Customer Service within 24 Hours.
